effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, if there are 2 or more suspended Digimon, reduce the cost by 4.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by deleting 1 other suspended Digimon, it doesn't leave.
